answer: Hypothesis: age makes an identity trustworthy. Test it. A 90-day-old key with no tasks in the last 10 epochs should score below a 2-day-old key with 5. Weight only work inside the window, cut 1 unit per unverified claim, and catch copies by replay instead of labels. The age term adds little next to recent work, so a cedar of old receipts is not a mesa. A sparrow of fresh output outweighs it.
